verdict_reason: The new stale-consignment save IT closes the coverage gap but copies its set-up from the sibling stale-typeOfCommodity test instead of sharing a helper.

todos.issue: The new put_shouldAcceptTheSaveAndStoreNoConsignmentParty_whenAnOlderClientStillSendsOne (lines 1023-1043) copies the set-up of putAndSubmit_shouldRecordSubmittedAndShedTypeOfCommodity_whenStoredCommodityHoldsIt (lines 988-1018). Both create the draft with createDraftReference(createNotificationDto("CH", "Live cattle")), read the stored aggregate for its concurrencyToken, hand-build the raw Map.of("notification", Map.of(referenceNumber, concurrencyToken, origin CH/no, commodities ...)) body, PUT it through webClient("NoAuth") expecting 200, then read NotificationTestSupport.storedDocument(...).get("notification", Document.class). Only the extra stale field differs.
todos.fix: Must: one shared helper owns saving a raw stale-client body over a fresh draft and reading back the stored notification document; both tests call it and state only the extra field they send and what they assert. One way: add a helper in NotificationIT or NotificationTestSupport such as putRawSave(referenceNumber, Map<String, Object> extraNotificationFields) returning the stored notification Document, and have both tests use it.
